source_requirements: Preserve complete generated project dependencies and core-specific settings
Record source revision, compiler identity, arguments, target part and split mode
Inventory all generated clocks, resets, controls, interfaces and optional ports
Resolve actual file paths and top module before adding any source list

requirements: Reserve the AFU DFH/UUID region separately from the AHLS shared CSR
Translate OPAE byte offsets, PIM word-addressed MMIO and generated agent address units explicitly
Add AFU image aperture base once; generated register macros may already include kernel base
Preserve byteenable, width adaptation, waitrequest and returned MMIO transaction user metadata
Do not make destructive register reads while splitting, probing or retrying accesses
Serialize argument writes and Start per invocation owner; account for independently selected conduit arguments
Read actual CSR map version and reject mismatched host ABI
CSR: wait until not busy, establish arguments, write Start, track completions
FinishCounter is clear-on-read and acknowledges completions; use a single completion owner
Record wait_for_done_write versus do_not_wait_for_done_write behavior
Conduit: bind actual start/ready and done/ready signals from generated metadata; preserve argument sampling
Do not assume ready_in exists when downstream stall is removed
If software controls a conduit invocation, a separately specified MMIO-to-invocation controller is required; none is supplied
Map every generated buffer_location to an explicit local-bank or host-memory address domain
Record widths, address units, burst count units, direction, alignment, latency and outstanding-response capacity
Adapt ordinary generated Avalon MM to split read/write PIM host memory when that path is selected
Do not wire byte addresses directly to PIM line addresses or discard sub-line byte enables
Preserve burst boundaries, response routing, backpressure and any required write completion semantics
Use OPAE-registered IOVA for a physical host-memory path; never substitute a process virtual pointer
Local-memory offsets require a separate placement and transfer mechanism, not fpgaPrepareBuffer alone
USM source annotations do not establish OFS shared virtual memory or translation support
Do not guess location routing bits for mixed annotated/unannotated pointers
Define host-visible ordering and quiescence independently of kernel done; a fence flag declaration alone does not prove end-to-end visibility
Internal inter-kernel pipes are not external endpoints
For each external endpoint record direction, protocol, actual signal names, payload packing, sidebands, symbol order and ready latency
Respect optional valid/ready removal and its always-available system obligations
Bind to an on-board producer/consumer or separately designed host transport
A generated Avalon-ST or AXI-stream pipe is not a PCIe DMA engine or an OPAE streaming API
Do not equate OFS PCIe TLP AXI streams with AHLS payload streams
Specify buffering, CDC, reset and concurrent service of connected endpoints without a fixed workload or packet format
Require register-mapped invocation for CSR pipes
Input with valid: wait valid=0, write all payload pieces, then write valid=1
Output with ready: wait ready=0, read all payload pieces, then write ready=1
Resolve reset/initial register state from generated IP before first transfer
Input without valid overwrites; output without ready exposes latest value, not a lossless queue
Do not manufacture an input ready register or an output valid register
Use generated offsets and widths, not handbook example constants; min_capacity is not a CSR FIFO depth
Control-pipe presence does not guarantee stop responsiveness when other operations block
Host-accessible device globals have an independent MM agent, not automatically the shared CSR
Bind all IP clocks/resets including polarity, reset synchronization and PIM CDC choices
Gate traffic until documented readiness, not merely external reset deassertion
Review freeze, interrupt, exception and any other generated controls individually
Tie off only unused platform resources with correct in-use masks; never tie off unknown required IP endpoints
Enumerate accelerator by the selected AFU UUID and resolve multiple matches deliberately
Open the exact accelerator context and check every API result
Discover/validate AFU identity, aperture layout and generated CSR version before control writes
Implement generated-register accesses using OPAE MMIO APIs with correct byte offsets and access widths
Prepare/register DMA buffers and retrieve IOVA only when the selected endpoint supports host memory
Keep registration, address mapping and accelerator handle alive until proven DMA quiescence
Specify ordered input publication and output visibility for the chosen platform path
Choose polling or an explicitly mapped interrupt path; AHLS irq does not automatically become OPAE notification
Bound waits and define failure/recovery semantics; a timeout is not evidence that DMA stopped
Drain or reset/quiesce safely before releasing buffers, closing or reprogramming
Do not require SYCL queue submission, OpenCL MMD hostchannels or oneAPI ASP runtime for this OPAE control layer

known_source_caveats.issue: Handbook sample repeats FINISHCOUNTER macro at 0x30 and 0x34; do not copy the example as a compilable register header
Sample comments mention input ready/output valid, but actual properties and handbook specify input valid/output ready only
CSR sample reads nonblockingly but OutputPipe::write is blocking; its stop-at-any-time comment is not a liveness guarantee
Platform Designer sample is Arria 10 plus JTAG, not an IA840F PCIe design; legacy oneAPI names are not compiler/runtime selection
